name: MacdPatternTraderAll
summary: This EA trades based on MACD divergence patterns combined with candlestick pattern recognition. It identifies various MACD histogram patterns (single, double, triple divergence) and enters trades when confirmed by corresponding candlestick formations. The EA supports multiple pattern types and applies fixed lot sizing with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于MACD背离形态与K线形态识别进行交易。它识别多种MACD柱状图形态（单重、双重、三重背离），并在相应K线形态确认时入场交易。EA支持多种形态类型，采用固定手数并配置可调的止损止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是MACD柱状图背离形态识别，结合K线确认信号进行交易。入场条件：当MACD柱状图出现特定形态模式（如单峰背离、双峰背离、三峰背离等）时，等待对应方向的K线确认形态出现后入场做多或做空。出场条件包括固定止损止盈，以及反向信号出现时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，由Lots参数控制每笔交易的下单量。资金管理方面没有动态仓位调整机制，不根据账户余额或风险比例自动计算手数。该策略还包含AllType参数来控制是否交易所有形态类型，以及MinStopLevel参数来确保止损距离满足经纪商最小要求。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy centers on MACD histogram divergence pattern recognition combined with candlestick confirmation for trade entries. Entry conditions trigger when MACD histogram forms specific pattern configurations (single, double, or triple divergence peaks) and a corresponding candlestick pattern confirms the directional bias before opening a long or short position. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, as well as position closing when a reversal signal appears. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach controlled by the Lots parameter for every trade. Money management lacks dynamic position sizing as there is no automatic lot calculation based on account balance or risk percentage. The strategy includes an AllType parameter to control whether all pattern types are traded, and a MinStopLevel parameter to ensure stop loss distances meet the broker's minimum requirements.

parameters.name: AllType
parameters.description: 是否交易所有形态类型

pros: 结合MACD背离与K线形态双重确认，入场逻辑较为严谨
支持多种MACD形态模式（单重、双重、三重背离），交易机会较多
参数结构清晰，止损止盈可配置，便于优化调整
pros_en: Dual confirmation using MACD divergence and candlestick patterns provides a more rigorous entry logic
Supports multiple MACD pattern types (single, double, triple divergence) offering more trading opportunities
Clear parameter structure with configurable stop loss and take profit facilitates optimization and tuning
cons: 固定手数下单缺乏动态资金管理，无法根据账户风险自动调整仓位
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
缺乏点差过滤，在点差较大时可能造成不必要的损失
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic money management and cannot adjust position size based on account risk
No new bar check mechanism may cause repeated trade opening on the same candle
Absence of spread filter can lead to unnecessary losses when spreads are wide
improvements: 增加基于账户余额百分比或ATR的动态仓位计算机制
添加新K线检查以防止同一根K线重复开仓，以及点差过滤机制
增加移动止损和保本止损功能以更好地保护利润
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account balance percentage or ATR for better risk adaptation
Implement new bar checking to prevent duplicate entries on the same candle, plus a spread filter mechanism
Add trailing stop and break-even stop functionality to better protect profits

risk_points: 缺乏新K线检查可能导致同一K线重复开仓增加风险敞口
固定手数不考虑账户规模变化，在小账户上风险可能过大
risk_points_en: Lack of new bar check may cause duplicate positions on the same candle increasing risk exposure
Fixed lot sizing does not account for account size changes, potentially creating excessive risk on small accounts
